manus: GTA 6 runs smoother on Xbox Series X than on a regular PS5. That's according to Digital Foundry. Both run at around 1440p and 30 frames per second, but the Series X drops frames less often. The PS5 Pro is the best overall, with near 4K and extra ray-traced shadows. The Xbox Series S is the weakest, dipping to around 20 frames in heavy action. And none of them run it at 60.
